_schema.note: Regenerate; never read-if-exists. A cache that can outrank its source is how 59 models shadowed 112 for five weeks.

stage.note: from the MODEL NAME where it carries the method, else from position. The four archangel arms differ only by method and a position-derived stage called all four dpo.

country.note: blank where ONE country would mislead -- RWKV, bigscience and m-a-p are multinational, and huggyllama is a re-uploader, not an originator

org_type.note: `government` was added because the original five had no slot for a state research institute -- TII is part of the Abu Dhabi government's ATRC and HF's own badge calls it a company

index_present.note: sharded checkpoints only; decides loadability where format does not

status.note: scoped to the ROSTER. ACTIVE and EXCLUDED are answers about coverage and only a model that was asked can hold one; NOT_IN_GRID is the registry rows the v3 grid never asked, which is not a coverage gap.

pending_repair.note: EXCLUDED rows only. 'excluded' and 'excluded until the repair pass' are different facts.

reads.smaller_sibling_of: {parent} is a smaller-parameter version of {child} FROM THE SAME RELEASE (same declared generation)
reads.smaller_predecessor_of: {parent} is a smaller-parameter model from an EARLIER GENERATION than {child} -- scale AND release differ, so this pair is not a scale contrast
reads.also_member_of: {parent} is also a member of family {child}

measurement_context.note: tokenizer and weight measurements are library-version dependent; the sweeps ran locally, the v3 grid ran on transformers 5.14.1 / torch 2.5.1
